course_name: 網路系統程式開發與安全
outline:
隨著金融交易、機器人應用等網路應用快速成長，系統需同時具備高擴展性、可靠性與安全性。為因應此趨勢，本課程培養學生具備從應用層到作業系統核心的程式開發實力，並強調 TCP/IP 通訊與系統架構整合。
With the rapid growth of internet services—such as financial transactions and robotic applications—modern systems must be scalable, reliable, and secure. This course addresses these needs by training students in programming skills from the application layer to the OS kernel, emphasizing TCP/IP networking and system architecture.
schedule:
1.Intro & Trends
2. Linux Basics
3.C Programming
4.Processes & Inter-process communications (1)
5.Processes & Inter-process communications (2)
6. Multi-Threads
7.TCP/UDP Sockets
8. Basic Client-Server
9. Mid-term
10. Blocking & Non-blocking I/O
11. Reliability and Scalability design
12  Secure Transfer design with TLS
13. Kernel  Programming basic
14. System Programming Architecture
15-17 System Programming Project (1)-(3)
18. Final Term
assessment:
• Homework, class participation: 30%
• Midterm report & presentation: 35%
• Final project: 35%
